latest_cos_commentary.headline: Altametrics is an enterprise restaurant back-office suite (scheduling, inventory, loss prevention) citing Five Guys and Jack in the Box as customers.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes on back_office and labor/workforce scheduling capabilities that overlap with back-office modules in Genius's product suite.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No recent (2026) funding, leadership, or product-launch news was found in this pass — appears to be a stable, lower-visibility competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where Altametrics is the incumbent back-office/scheduling system, expect displacement conversations to center on integration depth with POS rather than price.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Named-customer claims come only from the vendor's own site; current leadership and financial health could not be verified in this pass.
